verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v1: yā rabbi fājʿal lī biʾarḍi bul- mā shiʾita min khayri wamin tafaḍḍuli
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v2: wājʿal dharāhā jannata l-yaqīni wājʿal ḥimāhā ʾāyata lid-dīni
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v3: wājʿal bihā madīnata munawwarat wāsluk bihā l-madīnata l-munawwarat
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v4: wanashshiṭan rijālahā lil-ʿamali wanajjihim min sharri dhī t-taʿʿaṭuli
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v5: wakun lahum fīhā wakīlā dāʾimā wakun lahum jārā bihā mulāzimā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v6: wabārikan fīhim wafī fustuqihim wafī ʾakuffihim wafī ʾaswāqihum
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v7: wafī buyūtihim wafī l-masākini wafī ḥudūdihim maʿa l-ʾamākini
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v8: wājʿal bihā d-dukhna mughadhdhiyā ʿalā mā kāna min faḍli wamin jinsi ʿalā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v9: waṭayyibi l-māʾa bihā wat-turbā waṭayyibi l-hawā bihā wa l-kasbā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v10: wasakhkhiri n-nāra kabardi wasalām sahili l-marāma fīhā was-salām
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v11: wakuffa ʿayna s-sūʾi ʿan sāʾirihim warudda sharra l-kaydi ʿan dhākirihim
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v12: ʾin kāna bin-niyati kullu ʿamali faniyyatī bihā ḥifāẓu l-ʿamali
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v13: khayru mina l-ghībati ḥusnu dh-dhikri mā ʾaṭyaba dh-dhikra liʾahli l-fikri
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v14: walā ʾurīdu baʿdahā jazāʾā walā shukūrā lā walā ruwāʾā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v15: waʾinnamā l-ʿamalu ḥaẓẓu r-rajuli falyaʿmalan lil-hi kullu rajuli
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v16: walyaqṭaʿi l-ʾamyāla kullu rākibi wakullu rājili wakullu ṣāḥibi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v17: ʾamānatu ʾadāʾuhā saʿādat wadhimmahu ʾīfāʾuhā ʿibādat
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v18: waṣṣā bidhāka quṭbunā t-tijjānī waḥibbuhu mālikunā r-rabbānī
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v19: wakāna yaʾamur bihā min baʿdu ʾabū l-ḥabībi l-ʾandariyyū l-fardu
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v20: lidhā daʿawtukum bihā ʾikhwatī bijāhihim min dūni ʿayni s-saṭwati
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v21: liqāʾukum bihā maʿa l-wufūdi maʿnā mina r-ruqiyyī waṣ-ṣuʿūdi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v22: liʾannanā ʾabnāʾu khayri nahshali lā naddaʿī lighayrihi fī l-miʿqali
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v23: hal kāna mabdaʾu hunāka ʾawlā min ḥtifāẓikum biwirdi ʾaʿlā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v24: waʾin taʿāwanū waʾin taʿāḍadū biḥurmahi sh-shaykhi waʾin taʿāhadū
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v25: walaw taghghayara z-zamānu waghadā mā fīhi ʾaktharu l-warā taḥḥayudā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v26: walaw taṭawwarat bihi l-wasāʾilu wāntaṣabat fī ẓillihi l-ḥabāʾilu
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v27: qad qāla māliku faʾinna l-ʾamrā ʾamru waʾinna n-nahyā nahyu qarrā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v28: wallāhu lā yughghayiru l-ʾaḥkāmā fī l-ʾamri wan-nahyī walaw ʾayyāmā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v29: wafawqa kulli dhā lahu ʾirādat waḥikmaha fī zammihā qiyādat
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v31: wal-ḥukmu fash-sharʿu waʾamā l-ḥikmah fahyā l-mashīʾatu warāʾa l-ʾummah
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v32: ʾin shāʾa waffaqa waʾin shāʾa manaʿ wakullu shayʾi wāqiʿu kamā waqaʿ
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v33: wash-sharʿu sawṭuhu bihadhā n-nādī ʾammā l-mashīʾatu fat-tanādī
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v34: lakinnamā l-ḥayātu lil-ʾinsāni ʾishāratu liqudrati r-raḥmāni
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v35: mā kullu dharrati mina dh-dharrāti ʾila wafīhā ʾaʿjabu ṭ-ṭāqāti
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v36: min dharrati fī ḥajmihā taṣīru llāhi ʾarḍā fī l-qaḍā tasīru
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v37: ʾaw dharrati hiyā s-samāʾu was-samā fīhā mina l-ʾāyāti mā qad ʿulimā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v38: fī l-ʾarḍi ʾajnāsu mina d-dawābi wakullu jinsi jāʾa fī l-kitābi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v39: wal-baḥru wal-hawāʾu tawʾamāni wan-nāru wal-maʿdinu ʿunṣurāni
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v40: wal-ʿaqlu sirru llāhi fī taskhīri hadhī l-ʿanāṣiri madā l-ʿuṣūri
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v41: wal-fannu ʿinda baʿḍihim ḥikāyat ʿan mā ʿalayhi llāhu min bidāyat
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v42: huwa lladhī yabdaʾu bal yuʿīdu bilā mashaqqahi ʾatā l-majīdu
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v43: yakhluqu mā yashāʾā faʾimmā nabtā min ḥabbahi l-ʾarḍi waʾimmā zaytā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v44: wakullu shayʾi fīhi min ʾighnāʾi mā lā yuʿʿadu ʾāyata lir-rāʾī
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v45: wal-kullu fī sittati ʾayyāmi bilā sittati ʾayyāmi lahu qad ḥaṣalā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v46: ʾinna l-jarāthīma llatī lā taẓharu lil-ʿayni fahyā ḍiʿfu mā yustaẓharu
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v47: wafawqahā khalīqatu lā tudraku bil-ʿaqli wal-ʿaqlu bihā yustahlaku
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v48: jamaʿahā l-qurʾānu fī muḥammadi liʾannahu r-ramzu lladhī lam yujḥadi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v49: lidhāka ʾaḍḥā dīnuhu fī l-ʾummahi maʿnā mina l-hidāyati l-mutimmahi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v50: qad malaʾa d-dārayni hadhā d-dīnu saʿādata waʿilmuhu yabīnu
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v51: jāʾa bil-mabādiʾi l-ʿaliyyati siyāsata wamillaha saniyyah
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v52: wanaẓẓama l-mujtamaʿa l-mukhtārā lā ẓulma fīhi lā walā ʾinkārā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v53: waqāla lir-rūḥi taqaddamī walā taltafitī lighayri man thamma ʿalā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v54: waqāla lil-ʾakhlāqi faltattabiʿī sabīlahā min dūni ʾan tabtadiʿī
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v55: waqāla lil-māddati fākhdumīhimā wala tukhālifī l-ḥakīma fīhimā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v56: walam yakun fī dhāka lil-ʾinsāni ḥaẓẓu bidūni l-ʿilmi wal-ʿirfāni
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v57: hadhā biʿaqlihi wadhā bifiṭratihi nūrāni yahdiyāni naḥwa ḥaḍratihi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v58: ʾillā baqāyā l-ʾakli wallilbāsi wan-nawmu fī lawāzimi l-ʾajnāsi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v59: waghayru mā ʾanzalahu l-ʾilahu ḥukmā falā yaqbaluhu l-ʾawwāhu
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v60: ʾawlā bīttifāqihim bil-ḥurmahi mā kāna mansūbā liʾahli l-ḥikmahi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v61: ʾaṣbaḥa fī t-tanẓīmi raʾasamālī ʾaw shtirākiyā ʾaw ʿtizālī
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v62: fal-ḥujjahu l-ʾūlā hiyā l-ḥurūbu fī l-ʾittiḥādi s-sūfiyāti l-ḥūbu
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v63: ʾaw fī l-wilāyāti l-ʿulā l-muttaḥidat wamā bihā min fitani muttaḥidat
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v64: lā khayra fīhimā walaw tawaffarat ḥawlahumā l-ʾālātu ʾaw takaththarat
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v65: man lam yakun yaḥkumu bil-kitābi faḥukmuhu nawʿu mina l-ʿitābi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v66: walaysa baʿda llāhi min mustaʿtabi walā warāʾa l-muṣṭafā min madhhabi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v67: ʾinna ntisābuhum ʾilā bni maryami fakhru walakin lā yafī bil-maghnami
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v68: ʾidh lil-masīḥi fī hudāhu ʾikhwat ʾakrim bihim min khārati waṣafwat
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v69: wal-waʿdu fī ʿtirāfihim bil-jumlahi ʾammā l-waʿīdu fahyā nafyū ṣ-ṣilahi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v70: mūsā waʾibrāhīmu ʾaw muḥammadu ʾaw nūḥu lladhī bihim yukhalladu
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v71: sammāhum l-mawlā biʾūlī l-ʿazmi limā lahum min quwwati waḥazmi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v72: hadhā waʾinna d-dīna lā yukhālifu ḥawāditha d-dahri walā yuʿānifu
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v73: farubbamā ḥarrama ʾahlu d-dīni shayʾā faḥḥulila mina jli ṭ-ṭīni
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v74: lā ʾannahu muḥallalu walakin liḍuʿfi man ẓahra l-bisāṭi sākinu
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v75: walā naṣība baʿdu lil-ʾaʾimmahi ʾillā naṣību ṣ-ṣumti naḥwa l-ʾummahi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v76: ʾinna l-qawānīna fat-taʾadībi waʾinnahā l-ʾashkālu fī t-tartībi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v77: ʾammā l-ḥawādithu falā tazālu taruddu mā tulzimuhu l-ʾashkālu
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v79: wal-ʿilmu kunhuhu fal-mukawwini wal-ḥaqqu kulluhu fal-muhaymini
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v81: yā rabbi bīsmika l-ʿaliyyī nabdaʾu wafī riḍā minka ghadawnā nahdaʾu
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v82: bal fīhā nuwāṣilu l-ʾaʿmālā ʾaw bihimā nutābiʿu l-ʾashghālā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v83: lakinnanā fī ʿālami n-naqāʾiṣi man lī biḥḥaẓi minhu ghayru nāqiṣi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v84: wayassiran lanā s-sabīla rabbanā wājʿal lanā s-saʿyā ʿalayhā hayyinā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v85: waṭawwili l-ʿumra likulli wāḥidi waṣaḥḥiḥi l-jisma likulli wāfidi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v86: wakaththiri r-rizqa waʾaʿṭi l-barakah likulli man yakhtāru minnā l-ḥarakah
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v87: waltakhtim l-kulla ʾidhā khtamtā bikhayri mā takhtimu mā badaʾatā
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v88: biḥurmahi l-hādī n-nabī muḥammadi ṣallā ʿalayhi llāhu khāliqu l-yadi
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v89: wal-ʾāli waṣ-ṣaḥbi dhawī l-karāmat mā nushirat min dhikrihim ʿimāmah
verses.ya-rabbi-faj-al-li-bi-ardi-bulali-c1-v80: waghayru dhā takhabbuṭu fī l-layli waḥayratu maṣīruhā lil-wayli
